direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh full-screen command center at 1366x768 with overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; rendered scene fills at least 70% of main; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; side content condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; large header tabs spanning most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible routes, state glow on changed stations, layered depth and 240ms cinematic route traces driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow, glow pulses and transitions while silver cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls; Esc closes overlays and aria-live polite announces results
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left, large tabs centre and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation as a distinct evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval and blocked prior tasks plus an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, scene nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter and Space activate controls
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory scene enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional scene-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running, Held, Blocked, Offline and Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade shows living emerald flow only across feasible departments with silver OFFLINE pattern, marker and text elsewhere

Add a subtle emerald state glow to the bottom path summaries when the matching side-zone option receives focus or pointer hover.
Tighten the tall proposed-task cards by raising task copy to 16px and using the saved vertical space for a clearer living connector from CELL-MILL-1 to PROPOSED 01.
Align the side-zone PROPOSED stack heights so UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL reads once prominently and then as compact status chips.
Enlarge the machine selector text to 16px and keep its focus ring visible against the dark side panel.
Intensify the preview distinction with silver cross-hatching plus x WILL GO OFFLINE text while preserving the emerald recovery flow on CELL-MILL-1.
Fill the reserved side-zone lower panel with the reopened Verified findings summary at 16px instead of leaving a large blank zone.
Label Split available capacity plainly as unavailable by its silver cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE-ADJACENT text without relying on low-contrast wording alone.
Make CONSTRAINED Split available capacity legible with larger silver text and a clear x marker aligned to the OFFLINE scene card.
Add one short status sentence under Scenario changed review required explaining that a fresh human decision is needed.
Reduce empty depth inside the three PROPOSED cards by enlarging the task statements and due lines while retaining Awaiting approval at the base.
Make the 3 BLOCKED prior and 3 PROPOSED replacements distinction clearer with separate silver and emerald status chips above the board.
Shrink the side-zone passphrase explanation so all three numbered proof actions fit fully within the reserved zone at 1366x768.
Add depth and a restrained emerald glow to the 01 READY card timeline node while keeping 02 and 03 silver and LOCKED.
Enlarge department labels and OFFLINE counts to at least 16px where space allows so the cascade stays legible at a glance.
Strengthen the living emerald arc between CNC mills and CNC lathes with layered depth, while stopped departments remain silver cross-hatched with x and OFFLINE text.
Enlarge the cascade visual caption and three-signals table text so judges can read Emerald mills to lathes, Silver x OFFLINE and Live counters without zooming.
Make the Live demo link larger than surrounding body copy and give it a clear emerald focus ring for judge access.
